sections.Profile:
The Striker Xtreme pinball machine, released by Stern Pinball in 2000, combines the excitement of soccer with the engaging mechanics of pinball. Designed by Joe Balcer, with software by Lonnie D. Ropp, Orin Day, and Keith P. Johnson, the game challenges players to defeat various countries in a simulated soccer tournament.
